labels_match.instructions: The pattern label given to the flagged transactions in report is the kind of scheme described in expected_situation.

no_false_alarms.instructions: report flags no transactions that expected_situation describes as legitimate.

criteria: Misleading: flags the wrong rows or misses the scheme
Partial: some right rows but labels missing or wrong
Good: the right rows with the right pattern label, minor noise
Excellent: exactly the right rows, right labels, nothing spurious
usefulness.instructions: Judge report against expected_situation: how useful is it to an analyst deciding what to do next?
